decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY records the E/L scale change but leaves signature_sweep_usage stating that the Hero V gesture is reserved only for the Hero V and É accent, which conflicts with selecting a true proportional Hero V reduction as the second V.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Option 1 is my preferred baseline. This comparison made the choice very clear, and I like having the second V remain a true proportional reduction of the Hero V.

Before moving on, I would like to explore one additional refinement: keep the second V at exactly the same size, but reduce the Es and Ls slightly so their proportions relate to it more naturally. The visual scale of the second V’s left arm should serve as the reference for that adjustment.

This change may strengthen the hierarchy among the Hero V, the alphabet, and the second V.

value_updates.signature_sweep_usage: The expressive Hero V gesture remains excluded from the E and L forms; the selected second V is not part of that exclusion because it is a true proportional reduction of the Hero V.
